name: Ubuyama (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ubuyama village emblem in white: a stylised swirl with a disc, like a comma.
history: Municipal flag of Ubuyama, a village in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1974.

features.role: Ubuyama village emblem — a stylised swirl with a disc, like a comma
